thread.title: Apple Watch Sales Fuel Wearables Business For iPhone Maker

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Apple Watch Sales Fuel Wearables Business For iPhone Maker
text:
Wearable devices such as the Apple Watch provided a nice boost to Apple 's ( AAPL ) June-quarter results, company executives said.
X Over the last four quarters, sales of Apple wearable devices totaled more than $10 billion, Chief Executive Tim Cook said on a conference call with analysts late Tuesday. By comparison, wearable fitness device maker Fitbit ( FIT ) posted just $1.6 billion in sales over the past four quarters.
Apple includes three products in its wearables category: the Apple Watch smartwatch, Beats headphones and AirPods wireless earbuds. Sales of those products rose 60% year over year in the June quarter and accelerated from the March quarter, Cook said. Apple Watch alone recorded growth in the mid-40% range, he said.
"Our wearables revenue exceeded $10 billion over the last four quarters, a truly remarkable accomplishment for a set of products that has only been in the market for a few years," Cook said.

It lumps them into a line item called Other Products, which also includes HomePod, Apple TV, iPod Touch and other gadgets.
In the quarter ended June 30 , Other Products revenue rose 37% year over year to $3.74 billion. It's the company's smallest unit after iPhone, Services, Mac and iPad. But Other Products is Apple's fastest growing division.
How Many Apple Watch Units Did It Sell? Some analysts on Wall Street estimate Apple Watch sales by parsing data from the Other Products line item along with executive comments.
The consensus of 10 analysts who published Apple Watch data is that Apple sold 4.2 million smartwatches in the June quarter. That beat the forecast for 4 million units, according to FactSet.
"Apple Watch continues to be the best-selling smartwatch by a wide margin, and units and revenue grew dramatically during the quarter," Chief Financial Officer Luca Maestri said on the call with analysts.
Apple competes in the smartwatch category with Fitbit, Garmin ( GRMN ), Samsung and others.
For the current quarter, analysts are forecasting Apple to sell 4.93 million watches.
Apple stock jumped 5.9% to 201.50 on the stock market today . In intraday trading it notched an all-time high of 201.76.
